See the Whole Picture, Instantly.
​
Experience advanced imaging like never before, and let your doctor
see everything too.

Today, advanced diagnostic imaging depends on either large, expensive systems or highly specialized operators. As a result, imaging is scarce, workflows are fragmented, and clinicians are forced to wait for answers.

​

Vortex removes that dependency. We deliver fast, standardized, full-volumetric 3D imaging that is intuitive, operator-independent, and designed to work wherever clinical decisions are made.

This is advanced imaging, without the bottlenecks.

Contact us

Imaging Isn’t Keeping Up with Clinicians

Clinicians often wait for imaging results and rely on others to perform scans. These delays slow decisions, frustrate patients, and limit what can be done immediately.

Vortex Delivers a New Standard

Vortex provides fast, full volumetric 3D scans that are objective, quantitative, and ready when decisions need to be made.

The result: clinicians can act with confidence, make faster decisions, and provide better care every time.

From Geophysics to Medical Imaging

Vortex’s proprietary algorithm adapts full waveform inversion (FWI) - a geophysics technique once used to map underground structures, to reconstruct high-resolution, 3D medical images from raw sound data.
